info.name: Chaotic file cleaner
info.summary: Spin a wheel and let fate delete one of your files
info.description:
Chaotic file cleaner is the least responsible way to tidy up your Files.
Press the button, a wheel of your own files starts spinning, and whichever file it lands on gets deleted. No filters, no sorting, no mercy — just chaos.
Deleted files are moved to the trash bin (when the Deleted files app is enabled), so fate is at least reversible.
info.author: Example
